hero.title: Your logistics partner in Antwerp since 2004
hero.description: Scaldis Logistics grew from a single truck into a full-service transport and logistics company serving Belgium and all of Europe.

story.title: From one truck to a modern fleet
story.p1: Scaldis Logistics started in 2004 with a single truck and one clear promise: deliver on time, every time. Today a team of 120 people and 85 vehicles keeps goods moving across Belgium and Europe.
story.p2: We are based in the Port of Antwerp — the gateway to Europe — with a second depot in Leuven. That location lets us combine fast regional distribution with efficient international transport.
